text.tspan: its value, quality and growth are measured
value = highest passing value indicator score
quality = (return on invested capital (ROIC) − sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC)) + return on equity (ROE)
a missing ROE counts 0
growth = revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR) = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
growth = 0 when fewer than two years or first ≤ 0
it is ranked among the survivors

percentile = 0-based rank among distinct values ÷ (distinct values − 1)

it has a first-pass score
score = 100 × (0.40 × value + 0.30 × quality + 0.20 × growth + 0.10 × margin of safety)
